Global LLM_FAKE_PROVIDER and EMBEDDING_WARMUP_ENABLED removed so configuration tests exercise defaults. Individual tests control fake/mock providers.
environment.browser_environment: Local API8013; web3113 production build; QUESTION_AUTHORING_ENABLED=true, DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true, LLM_FAKE_PROVIDER=true, EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=hashing, EMBEDDING_WARMUP_ENABLED=false. Synthetic fixture users and Markdown source; no real model call.

coverage: Teacher API and browser: source upload, classified generation, edit answer/source mapping, approve, matching blueprint creation and publish, denied post-approval edit.
All four payload types, paired/null classification, same-course sources/outcomes, nonmember/student/admin denial, legacy metadata preservation, edit/review race and off-switch behavior.
Direct SQL and mutation checks prove question identity, review/history immutability, RLS, worker privilege and reference-row locking.
375px light/dark editing screenshots visually inspected; no horizontal overflow. Existing full browser flows pass.
compatibility: Existing blueprint fixture classifies draft before review; legacy RLS mutation assertion writes review metadata so payload guard cannot mask broken RLS. Sequential old/new SQL mutation gates leave the template dump unchanged.
limitations: No real-provider pedagogical acceptance, independent human approval, staging, canary, production or deployed rollback drill.
Native browser Back inside App Router does not prompt for unsaved edits; refresh and link navigation do. Save before Back.
Metadata-bearing legacy rubric lists keep structural/text identity; weights remain editable. Ordinary rubrics can be fully edited.
Credential scan checks common token/private-key patterns in changed files; it is not an exhaustive secret-scanner certification.
privacy: Only synthetic fixtures, repository-relative paths, command descriptions and aggregate counts are retained. No identifiable student content, raw provider payload or live credential.
